propositions: ChatGPT sessions operating in connector-limited environments (no local clone, no Gerrit access, no mounted tracker) require documented safe-operation guidance explaining which operations remain possible and when native ticket creation is impossible.

The native-creation impossibility criterion must be precisely defined as tracker-worktree failure AND (network/remote failure OR missing rebar/rebar-mcp binary), and guidance must state this rule explicitly to avoid executor inference.

Fallback ticket payloads for out-of-band submission must conform exactly to export.schema.json's required fields (schema_version, ticket_id as agent-generated UUID4, ticket_type, title, status) plus description and parent_id, producing the same shape as rebar export for operator review and conditional rebar import.

The rebar import mechanism must be documented as the sole sanctioned exceptional ingest path, accepting NDJSON (not raw events), assigning fresh local ids/HLC timestamps, and remaining idempotent by source_id, with the precise behavior that missing-ticket_id/ticket_type records are silently skipped in --dry-run mode with no warning or counter increment.

Detection of malformed import records in dry-run mode requires a would_create + skipped == total record count comparison, since missing-required-field records are invisible to both counters individually.
Post-import validation must explicitly require rebar validate or rebar fsck and confirmation of target branch freshness via git fetch and rebar exists against known-id.
